description: Checks the published Buzz conversion image tag on cnv.event.prod.bidr.io/log/cnv. Impression and click event routes, cookie sync, and /log/pbk postbacks stay outside this pack.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: Buzz generates the tag identifier and the conversion tag guide says not to edit it. The sample is numeric, and the page does not publish a character grammar, so only presence is checked.
params.fix_hint: Keep the tag_id from the conversion tag Buzz generated.

params.name: buzz_key
params.description: Buzz generates the account instance key and the conversion tag guide says not to edit it. The Buzz Key page says that value uses only alphanumeric characters.
params.fix_hint: Keep the alphanumeric buzz_key from the conversion tag Buzz generated.

params.name: value
params.description: When present, the conversion tag guide says to set value to a number, and the published example is 30. Omitted values use the number stored on the Buzz event. This check accepts a non-negative integer or decimal and warns on anything else, because the page does not publish a sign, exponent, or separator grammar.
params.fix_hint: Set value to a non-negative number, or omit it to use the Buzz event value.

params.name: segment_key
params.description: The conversion tag guide says a segment id is generally set when the event is created and should not be edited. It does not require the parameter on every tag, and it does not publish a character grammar.
params.fix_hint: Keep the segment_key Buzz generated, or omit it.

params.name: order
params.description: When present, the conversion tag guide says to set order to a number of items, and the published example is 2. Omitted values use the number stored on the Buzz event. This check accepts a non-negative integer or decimal and warns on anything else, because the page does not publish a sign, exponent, or separator grammar.
params.fix_hint: Set order to a non-negative number, or omit it to use the Buzz event order.

params.name: ord
params.description: The conversion tag guide says the implementation requirement is to replace [CACHEBUSTER] with a random number generated at runtime. The published script uses Math.floor, so this check expects a non-negative integer of digits. The page does not publish a maximum length.
params.fix_hint: Set ord to a random whole number generated when the tag fires.
